title: Coral DNA Extraction - Modified DNeasy PowerSoil Pro Kit
author: Luigi Colin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bww6pfhe

steps.title: Crush coral tissue
steps.instruction: Gently crush ~100 mg of coral in a mortar and pestle (avoid overloading the column), optionally using a scalpel to add more tissue and less carbonate, then transfer the crushed material to a PowerBead Pro Tube or 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add Buffer CD1
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of Buffer CD1 to the tube and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 83 µL of Proteinase K (Qiagen Catalog #19131, 2 mL stock) and vortex briefly. (Note: Proteinase K quality can be adjusted depending on sample type.)

steps.title: Add Buffer CD2
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Buffer CD2 and vortex for 5 seconds (00:00:05).

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Microcentrifuge the mixture at 16 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube (maximum 700 µL capacity); expect ~650 µL of liquid.

steps.title: Add Buffer CD3
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL of Buffer CD3 to the transferred supernatant and vortex for 5 seconds (00:00:05).

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column
steps.instruction: Load the lysate onto the MB Spin Column and perform the following actions:

substeps.instruction: Load 650 µL of lysate onto the column and centrifuge at 15 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute.
Repeat loading the remaining lysate to ensure all liquid passes through the column.

steps.title: Place column in collection tube
steps.instruction: Carefully place the MB Spin Column into a clean 2 mL collection tube, avoiding any splashing of flow‑through onto the column.

steps.title: Wash with Solution EA
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Solution EA to the column, centrifuge at 15 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute, then discard the flow‑through while keeping the column in the same 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Solution C5
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Solution C5 to the column, centrifuge at 15 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through, and transfer the column to a new 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Final spin to dry
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at up to 16 000 × g, room temperature, for 3 minutes, then carefully place the MB Spin Column into a new 1.5 mL elution tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50–100 µL of Solution C6 to the centre of the white filter membrane (use the lower volume for higher yield) and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes. Then centrifuge at 15 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute, discard the column. The eluate now contains DNA ready for downstream applications.

steps.title: Post‑elution incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the eluate at 56 °C for 60 minutes. Vortex for 10 seconds every 15 minutes (or place on a shaking heat block with full shaking; if using an orbital incubator, shake at ≥300 rpm to skip vortexing). An extra hour of incubation can increase yield, but incubation longer than 2 hours may shear long DNA fragments.
